summary: Dependency resolved from arbitrary non-registry URL on an unrelated host; shipped code is a stub
details: package.json line 12 declares its sole dependency, "linker-client-string-async", as the bare URL https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that mutable, unpinned, integrity-unchecked URL returns and installs them, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in that archive on the installer's machine. The host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage for this package. The package's own shipped code is a one-line re-export stub, so the manifest line is effectively the entire published surface: the only install-time effect is pulling and running third-party-controlled code, and the stub also loads that dependency on require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
